struck: Its rules take effect when adopted, must be given to a member who asks, and stay enforceable only if recorded by January 10.
use: Rules take effect when adopted. An association must give a member a copy on request unless they are posted in a common area or on its website.

struck: South Carolina law puts no limit on an association's rental rules.
use: Neither South Carolina's HOA Act nor its condo law caps an association's rental rules or exempts owners who bought before a new one.

struck: In Florida, a new condo rule that bans or limits renting applies only to owners who agree to it and to later buyers.
use: In Florida, a condo declaration amendment that bans or limits renting binds only owners who agree to it and later buyers.

pattern: \blodging tax\b[^.]{0,160}\bunless the home is rented fewer than 15 days\b
struck: South Carolina charges its lodging tax when a home is rented to the same guest for less than 90 days in a row, unless the home is rented fewer than 15 days in the year.
use: It does not apply to a home rented fewer than 15 days in the year, or to rooms rented in the owner's own home with fewer than six bedrooms.
